adherence-logging-and-attestation.reason: This attestation covers the session record above: a vocabulary-only session that corrected two of its own earlier reports (the ramp-gradient determination is retired, not standing at 5%; the 2009 full-text retrieval it recommended is closed by the 2026-09-25 ruling), promoted nine existing quantity terms to parameters on the owner's direction, and had its catalogue plan failed on three of four requirements by an independent critic before a rewrite.

deviations.reason: The nine base_parameters rows were applied through a data migration and committed on the work branch (a8b7c11, [skip ci]) with no pull request, no session record and no attestation, which the independent critique called out. The owner's D2 'yes' is the review. This record and attestation are the repair. Eight of the nine terms have no adjudication behind them, so no gate examines the rows themselves.

No adversarial pass was run on the rows: base_parameters is outside the 2026-08-19 rule's list of research tables, and adversarial_pass_audit reports nothing in scope. A read-only critique was run on the catalogue PLAN at the owner's express commission, which supersedes for that plan the 2026-08-19 clause barring critiques of plans; the ledger records this in prose because the back-pointer grammar cannot mark a clause that sits in the ledger itself.

Ten read-only commands run before /session-open were logged into the closed batch 23 session's commands.jsonl. They were moved to this session's log and the batch 23 file was restored to its committed state with git checkout, an edit to a closed session's record.

Three one-paragraph SUPERSEDED IN PART markers were inserted into scratchpad/session_2026-10-01-research-batch-23/process-gap-remediation-plan.md, a closed session's file, because the back-pointer audit requires currency to live at the superseded text. bias_direction: The session that seeded the nine rows also wrote the record, the plan that justifies them, and the briefs given to the agents that reviewed that plan, so the review is shaped by what the author chose to show it; the nine terms were also chosen by the same author from definitions alone, with a conservative bias toward leaving out doubtful quantities.
independent_reviewer_counterclaim: The strongest objection is that a session which first reported a retired determination as standing, and recommended a retrieval the owner had already ruled closed, should not be trusted to have chosen the nine terms either: at least two of them are named differently from the phrases the held codes use (turning circle where the ADA text says turning space; headroom clearance where sources say vertical clearance), one term's definition states a direction (operating force: 'Maximum force'), and no source has been read against any of the nine. The rows could be wrong in kind, not only in name, and the only review is the owner's one-word approval.
